title: Repo Scope Manifest
description: Meta-schema for `scope.json` at the root of every ChittyOS repository. The repo IS itself a registered scope — this manifest mirrors the chittyos-core `scopes` table (migration 002) at the repo level and supports prototypal inheritance via parent_scope_id for nested sub-services in `scopes/`.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI — should resolve to this meta-schema

id.description: UUID of this scope (matches scopes.id in chittyos-core). Optional at repo level — chittyregister will mint one on registration.

chitty_id.description: ChittyID format VV-G-LLL-SSSS-T-YM-C-X where T ∈ {P,L,T,E,A}. Required for registered scopes.

scope_type.description: Free-text taxonomy — zero-DDL extensibility. Common values: service, library, plugin, agent, tool, template, monorepo, application.

characterization.description: Mirrors scope_characterization enum in chittyos-core scopes table

parent_scope_id.description: UUID of the parent scope. Null for root repos. Sub-services in `scopes/<child>/scope.json` reference their parent's id.

owner_org.description: GitHub organization that owns this repo

trinity.description: Index of where each trinity layer lives. Allows tooling to locate paths without globbing.

identity.description: ChittyID layer — what this service IS

inherits.description: Prototypal inheritance from parent_scope. Each trinity layer can independently inherit (true) or override (false). Authority defaults to true (children inherit parent's CHARTER/canon by default).

overrides.description: Explicit overrides applied on top of inherited content from parent_scope.

disabled.description: Names of parent agents to disable for this child

registered_with.description: ChittyOS services this scope is registered with (chittyregister, chittyschema, chittycertify, etc.)
